'''Outpost Largona''', also known as '''Largona Outpost''', was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Largona
was situated in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] region, just north of the canyon known as [[The Wound]]. It featured a full medical center, run by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Aidarro]], and an Anchorhead militia garrison. Notable inhabitants were the militia officer [[Jule (Tatooine)|Jule]], [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Larcoh]], [[Fez Burba]], [[Dester]], and [[Bleb-Blek]].

==Behind the scenes==
Outpost Largona was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears as one of the Republic settlements on the planet Tatooine.
